question: What was Salesforce's current RPO at the end of Q2 FY2027, its YoY growth in both nominal and constant currency, and what share of total RPO it represents?
grading: cRPO ±0.5%, USD billions; growth rates exact as disclosed (both labeled correctly); share ±1pp
answer: Salesforce cRPO at July 31, 2026 was USD 33.5 billion, up 14% YoY in both nominal and constant currency terms. Total RPO was USD 66.3 billion, so cRPO represented 50.5279% of total RPO. [G07-E1]

output.answer:
## Salesforce Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026)

**Current RPO (cRPO):** **$33.5 billion**

- **YoY growth:** **up 14%** in nominal (U.S. GAAP, as-reported terms)
- **Constant-currency growth:** **up 14% CC** — i.e., identical to the nominal rate this quarter (no material FX impact on cRPO growth)
- Notably, this represented an **acceleration** from 13% Y/Y CC in Q1 FY27.

**Total RPO:** **$66.3 billion**, up **11% Y/Y**

**cRPO as a share of total RPO:** $33.5B ÷ $66.3B ≈ **50.5%** — so roughly half of Salesforce's total remaining performance obligation is billable/recognizable within the next 12 months.

### Source
- Salesforce Q2 FY27 press release, "Salesforce Delivers Record Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results" (Aug 26, 2026): https://www.salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2026/08/26/fy27-q2-earnings
- Salesforce Investor Relations: https://investor.salesforce.com/news/news-details/2026/Salesforce-Delivers-Record-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Results/default.aspx
- 24/7 Wall St. Q2 FY27 summary (notes cRPO +14% Y/Y CC, up from 13% in Q1): https://247wallst.com/companies/crm/earnings

**Note on the constant-currency caveat:** Because the reported and CC growth rates are both 14%, there was essentially no meaningful FX drag/benefit on cRPO this quarter. This can differ from other metrics — e.g., subscription & support revenue was up 12% Y/Y but only 11% CC, and total revenue was up ~11% in both.
